Page 36 Cont.
May 2 Thanks- Frank Sobe11 - 19 - reported Febr. 9th "Missing" Was enrolled in Seraphic Masses Febr. 19 (?) Mother comes To-day happy to have received letter from him yesterday ... released from Navy prison after 89 days. Offers $100.00 in thanksgiving.
6 Thanks - Robert Bon - soldier - 20 - had back broken - spinal con- cussion from shell-blast in France July 26, '44 in English hospi- tal 6 2 months - Mother enrolled him in Ser. Mass .. is here To-day .O.K.
.
Page 37 May 6th Josephine Cornella - 23 - anxious her girl-friend did away with herself ..... has been worrying ever since.
8 John Meyer - 47 - neglecting house - beer gardens and B. company. M. Francis - 4 - high fever - very threatening case of measles.
9 Patricia Schryer - 3 - Beautiful little - but unable to stand a- lone or speak a word. She smiles and seems happy and gives very little trouble ??? An aunt of the child, fears that the parents have not been to confession since married. Enrolled perpetually To-day (5.)
May 13 Mrs. Grace M. Gustof(son) of no religion - Elderly - Now in Cal- ifornia in Hospital - cancer - Catholic daughter - in - law phones for prayers ....
13 Donald - Sgt. Williams - 25 - over seas eleven months ... lost mem- ory while in New Guinea .... parents ask for prayers that he speed- ily recover.
Page 38 May 25th Mrs. Catherine Nagle - 45 - mother 8 - threatening tumors - in fact Dr's having opened her up for operation seem to have been hopeless of any operation and sewed her up. Has been enrolled number of times. Today Husband Enrolls PP. Souls - Whole family storming heaven by daily Communion - leaving Prov. Hospital To- day unable to take food.
29th Thank -- Mrs. Nagle as above 25th - Fearful swelling in abdomen gone - Seems to have good apetite and normal eats. Husband enrolls PP. Souls again 10. Un-2-2608. June 5 Answered phone June 5th O.K. June 10 here Today looking swell!
